title: Domestication of L0 Parts for Loop Type IIS (BsaI and SapI)
author: Eftychis Frangedakis
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.92jh8cn
materials: Amplify the parts using your preferred polymerase (e.g. Phusion, Thermo Scientigic™) following the manufacturer instructions.
Extract the amplified fragments using a PCR purification kit (e.g. Qiagen MinElute™ ).

steps.title: Design overlapping PCR primers
steps.instruction: Design four primers for the overlapping PCR: primer 1 and primer 4 according to the L0‑part cloning guidelines for pUAP4; primer 2 (reverse primer for fragment 1) and primer 3 (forward primer for fragment 2) each contain a single‑nucleotide mismatch that eliminates the internal BsaI or SapI site without changing the encoded amino‑acid (if in coding region) and also embed a SapI recognition site to enable later SapI‑type IIS assembly. Note that the pUAP4 backbone carries a chloramphenicol resistance (CmR) cassette and a lacZα cassette for blue‑white screening.

substeps.instruction: Design primer 1 (upstream forward) per pUAP4 L0 guidelines.
Design primer 2 (upstream reverse) with a single‑base mismatch to disrupt the BsaI/SapI site and add a SapI site.
Design primer 3 (downstream forward) with a single‑base mismatch to disrupt the BsaI/SapI site and add a SapI site.
Design primer 4 (downstream reverse) per pUAP4 L0 guidelines.

steps.title: Amplify upstream and downstream fragments
steps.instruction: Perform two separate PCR reactions: use primers 1 + 2 to amplify the upstream fragment (fragment 1) and primers 3 + 4 to amplify the downstream fragment (fragment 2) of the region to be domesticated.

substeps.instruction: Set up PCR for fragment 1 with primers 1 and 2.
Set up PCR for fragment 2 with primers 3 and 4.

steps.title: Run PCR products on agarose gel
steps.instruction: Load the PCR products of fragment 1 and fragment 2 onto an agarose gel, run electrophoresis, and visualise the bands to confirm correct size and purity.

steps.title: Calculate fragment concentrations for assembly
steps.instruction: Determine the required DNA concentrations (ng µL⁻¹) using the provided formulas: [pUAP4] = (plasmid length in bp) ÷ 200 and [fragment] = (fragment length in bp) ÷ 100.

steps.title: Assemble fragments into pUAP4
steps.instruction: Set up a SapI‑type IIS assembly mixing fragment 1, fragment 2 and the pUAP4 vector at the concentrations calculated above, allowing SapI digestion and ligation to join the two fragments into the vector.
